The research material doesn't give a number for this. It has no HQLA, net outflow or deposit-mix figures, so I can't calculate how much loan growth 113% LCR allows.

What it does say:
LCR is 113%. That's inside the 110–120% band management targets, but below its 115% "ideal" [Q2FY27 call].
Management says the bank used liquidity to fund growth, and needs about 115% to keep loan growth going [Q2FY27 call].
Deposits grew 18.8% YoY against loan growth of 15.3%, so funding is catching up [Q2FY27 call].
The 110% floor gives about 3 points of room, but the material doesn't turn that into a loan figure.
Business banking growth is guided at 18–21% [Q4FY26 call].

This is worth asking management directly.
